correctness.rationale: Van Tilborg's two published distance-class inequalities give the exact upper bound \(|A||B|\le14\) at length \(3\). Equality then forces sizes \(2\) and \(7\); the direct collision-pair argument proves the antipodal-minus-one characterization. Exhaustive enumeration of all \(65025\) ordered nonempty subset pairs independently reproduces the maximum, all \(16\) extremizers, and their structure.

value.rationale: This is a natural equality problem for a classical sharp zero-error bound, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The result identifies the complete extremal structure, exact count, and symmetry orbit at the first odd length following the standard sharp length-two example, furnishing a finite benchmark for binary-adder constructions and graph formulations.
